subject: general
question: Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Wildlife Sanctuary is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary** is in **Bhagalpur District **of Bihar, India.
 
• The sanctuary is 60 kilometres stretch of the Ganges River from Sultanganj to Kahalgaon in the Bhagalpur district.
 
• It was notified as** Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary in 1991.**
 
• Major attractions are the Ganges river dolphins which are classified as endangered on the 2006 IUCN Red List of Threatened Species.
 
• The sanctuary also contains a rich diversity of other threatened aquatic wildlife, including the Indian smooth-coated otter (Lutrogale perspicillata), gharial (Gavialis gangeticus) and a variety of freshwater turtles, and 135 species of waterfowl.​

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Some important wildlife sanctuaries are**:

 
 
• Jim Corbett National Park, Uttarakhand.
 
• Ranthambore National Park, Rajasthan.
 
• Gir National Park, Gujarat. 
 
• Kaziranga National Park, Assam. 
 
• Kanha National Reserve, Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Periyar National Park, Kerala. 
 
• Sundarbans National Park, West Bengal.
 
• Bandhavgarh National Park, Madhya Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **There are 573 existing wildlife sanctuaries in India covering an area of 123,762.56 km2, which is 3.76% of the geographical area of the country (National Wildlife Database Centre, Nov. 2023). **
 
• **Another 218 sanctuaries are proposed in the Protected Area Network Report covering an area of 16,829 km2.**
